verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer gaming GPU with no NVLink support (NVLink was dropped from GeForce cards after the 30-series), no Infinity Fabric (an AMD interconnect, not NVIDIA), and no documented rack-scale/multi-GPU datacenter deployment story. Evidence only covers gaming features (DLSS, Reflex), local AI inference tools (ComfyUI, Ollama), and CUDA/Nsight developer tools—none address datacenter-scale interconnect or multi-GPU rack deployment.
